claim: When do meat prices drop at sams club? : r/BBQ - Reddit
summary: Prices also vary club to club. So if you have more than one in the area call around. Also Sam's club does case pricing on 90% of the things they use either in HMS or cafe so if you like the plates they use at the cafe or the honey mustard they use in the sandwich trays you should be able to order a case. Meat also is sold case price as well.
